historical_references.reference: The Irishay or the Irawatis were one of the powerful clans of the Vedic period, mentioned in the Mahabharata and the Rigveda. They were known for their warrior prowess and were part of the great Kurukshetra war.
The Irishay or Irayanar are also known as the rulers of the southern region of Tamil Nadu during the Sangam period. They were prominent patron of Tamil literature, arts, and culture.
